title: Tesla Coil Plasma Globe
description: A surreal painting of a large plasma globe with glowing purple and cyan electrical arcs. Inside the sphere, a man wearing a black beret and green scarf stands on the left while a metallic green Oscar statue stands on the right, both observing the central glowing orb and miniature boats floating below.
prompt: Surreal painting of a large plasma globe device with vibrant purple and cyan electrical arcs radiating from a central glowing orb. Inside the transparent sphere, a man with a black beret, round glasses, and flowing green scarf stands on the left, facing a shiny metallic green Oscar statue posed on the right. Miniature glowing boats float at the bottom of the globe. Dramatic lighting, painterly brushwork, set against a dark purple background.
